In `deployment.c4`, I was about to add `Prod.Web.webApp -[https]-> Prod.App.apiApp` and `Prod.App.apiApp -[tcp]-> Prod.Data.dbApp` so the diagram shows protocols and ports. Is that the right place, or should those technologies live somewhere else?
